text: As I stand here, the world feels tilted and slightly surreal, as if the ordinary sharpness of office glass and practical furnishings slips into abstraction. The vacated meeting room evokes anticipation, as though I am on the edge of a conversation not yet begun. Moving through to the exhibition space with vibrant colors and bold text, my curiosity stirs—'R + D' glows with promise, drawing me toward the interplay of knowledge, creativity, and the human urge to innovate. I feel a subtle awe at the constructed environments where intellect and collaboration manifest so tangibly. A quiet excitement runs through me, realizing that this space is both boundary and bridge between ideas and reality.
